relation_to_existing_evidence.received_text_existing_claim: Existing 13WS cites received digital 《元史》卷54 用減定差一千一百一十一萬; this is only a digital textual claim, not a direct 1370 print-glyph reading.
relation_to_existing_evidence.expected_target: Does Zhejiang Library's edition-classified 1370 copy at 志第六 / 求遲疾差 print 定差一千一百一十一萬 or another variant?
false_independence_guards: Bibliographic classification, an indexed Commons filename, and a later Wikisource transcription are three evidence grades, not three physical witness votes.

The public inventory's Zhejiang volume is not yet item-level crosslinked via identical page or ownership marks to official catalog item03581; treat same-holding identity as HIGH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE pending page/holding binding.
No original scan, folio, raw PDF SHA, plate identity or typography was examined, hence no direct early glyph award and no genealogy edge.
Published Yuan史 work date 1370 and today's digitized copy metadata must not be conflated with a physically verified 1370 impression at the target leaf.
This source can test the Yang Zan constant phrase, but cannot by itself solve Xu-An juan45 table-B L132 damaged glyph, native 疾 捷法 constructor, 少微 carry or G893 same-field six numerical targets.
